title: Improve AI provider setup settings with official login and API key flow
measurement_note: Timing record was created after the task began, so phases are recorded as completed but not measured.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Ollama docs were checked before implementation.

phases.label: Source inventory
phases.bottleneck_notes: Existing ProviderAccountsPanel, provider commands, CSS, and readiness tests were inspected.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.bottleneck_notes: Created requirement, spec, plan, tasks, validation, traceability, and research records.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Extended provider settings UI with guide, filters, status pills, model refresh, and work default selection.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran renderer and platform tests/checks; fixed platform readiness issue around button overflow wrapping.

phases.label: Browser smoke
phases.bottleneck_notes: Opened the static build and verified the settings provider panel DOM.

phases.label: Internal package build
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran internal Tauri package build, app signature verification, and DMG verification.

phases.label: Evaluation and close-out records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added omission, resource, work summary, evaluation, and request trace records.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: Internal package build is expected to be the slowest phase because it includes renderer build, Rust build, Tauri bundling, codesign, and DMG verification.
improvement_candidates: Keep the prepared renderer path for repeated internal package builds.
Keep platform readiness CSS checks early so small UI regressions fail before packaging.
